create_milvus_client: create a MilvusClient instance that connects to a Milvus server and sets up multi-tenant shared collections
upsert_vector_items: upsert a list of VectorItem objects into a Milvus collection with multi-tenant resource routing
search_similar_vectors: search a Milvus collection for similar vectors filtered by resource_id and return top-k results
delete_collection_items: delete items from a Milvus collection by id list, metadata filter, and multi-tenant resource id
reset_milvus_collections: reset all shared Milvus collections by dropping them from the database
